claim: "Fondo compared to the alternatives" – "A modern accounting platform vs. legacy approaches." The comparison table's columns name two alternatives: "Pilot" and "CPA/Accounting Firm" (CPA = certified public accountant).
evidence: competitors.csv holds 22 direct competitors (13 material, 7 minor, 2 micro; a floor), each passing the same three-job test on its own site. Material direct rows besides Pilot: Zeni, Haven, Every, Puzzle, Kruze Consulting, Burkland Associates, inDinero, Bookkeeper360, Graphite Financial, Aprio, Escalon, Rivet. The generic "CPA/Accounting Firm" column can stand for the firm-type rows; the startup-specialist platforms Haven, Zeni, Every and Puzzle are not named.
